name: Oh My Vault!
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Caesius_Leo
description:
This datapack/mod enables reusability of all the vaults!
Now you can use the same trial vaults all the times that you want!
To refill a vault just go near them with a key in your main hand
evidence: Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
